name: The Tech Interactive Teen Volunteer Program (Holiday Helper)
what_you_do: Teen volunteers lead hands-on science, tech and art activities for museum visitors. This is during the holiday season. Volunteers complete six shifts. Each shift is 3 to 4 hours.
who_can_apply: Teens who are 14 or older by Nov 21, 2026.
duration: Six shifts in the peak windows: Nov 21 to 29 and Dec 19 to Jan 3
deadline_text: The official page gives no application dates as of Oct 9, 2026.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply Here link on the official page (vhub.at/TeenVolunteer). Questions: volunteer@thetech.org or 408-294-8324.
notes: The Oct 7 card said applications open Oct 9 to Oct 23, 2026. On Oct 9 the official page no longer shows that window, and the apply hub page shows no dates in its HTML (its content loads with JavaScript), so the status is unconfirmed. Re-check the official page for a new window. The page lists three mandatory 3.5-hour orientation and tour sessions on Saturdays Nov 14, Nov 21 and Dec 5, 2026, 9:00 AM to 12:30 PM. Applications are reviewed after the deadline by availability and answers. The page gives no year for Jan 3. The page's email addresses are encoded and could not be re-read on Oct 9; the email is kept from the Oct 7 read.
